data.body: Pushed Gerrit change 3278 (patch set 1, revision b82e68793b20d6c881c2962396bc944d17351e63): repoints docker-compose.langfuse.yml minio to cgr.dev/chainguard/minio@sha256:3c60a2a8c4d33409a9bc7a623a7fcbfb4605adc3d89422d2f53b3f673a6e5597 and adds tests/unit/test_langfuse_compose_images.py. Both new tests failed on the unfixed tree (2 failed) and pass after the fix; tests/unit/test_uv_pin_guard.py plus the new module: 46 passed; python scripts/check_uv_pin.py exit 0; make lint exit 0; 197 targeted policy/compose tests passed. Local full-stack proof: docker compose -f docker-compose.langfuse.yml up -d on the committed file brought all 6 services up, minio healthy, /api/public/health OK after 7 tries and /api/public/projects OK after 1 try. make verify still running on a heavily loaded host (load average ~50 on 18 cores).
